en.services.ai.capture.s1_a: Keep the phone level and aimed at the centre of the room. Follow one continuous circle at a steady distance and speed.
en.services.ai.capture.s1_b: Turn through corners gradually. Do not stop and pivot.
en.services.ai.capture.s1_title: Walk one slow loop, facing inward.
en.services.ai.capture.s2_a: At the loop start, hold your position and tilt upward smoothly. Complete the full inward-facing circle, then tilt down smoothly at the start point and complete the circle again.
en.services.ai.capture.s2_b: Tilt slowly while stationary. The high and low passes each need one complete walking loop.
en.services.ai.capture.s2_title: Complete one high loop and one low loop.
en.services.ai.capture.s3_a: Hold the phone in the same steady manner and look across the walls at diagonal angles as you walk. These sharper views give flat surfaces enough parallax and help prevent floaters.
en.services.ai.capture.s3_b: Keep moving with overlap; cover each wall from more than one oblique angle.
en.services.ai.capture.s3_title: Add oblique views of the walls.
en.services.ai.capture.subtitle: Record video
en.services.ai.capture.upload_hint: Keep this screen open — closing it stops the upload.
en.services.ai.capture.video_missing: The video file is no longer on this phone — record the room again.
en.services.ai.capture.w1_a: A fast yaw spin at the centre creates no sideways movement for depth. Abrupt tilt jumps also remove the intermediate views that a smooth tilt preserves.
en.services.ai.capture.w1_b: Walk for yaw coverage. When changing tilt at the loop start, do it slowly and smoothly.
en.services.ai.capture.w1_title: Do not yaw or tilt from one spot.
en.services.ai.capture.w2_a: Walking slowly to a corner and then snapping the phone toward the next wall breaks the smooth chain of overlapping views.
en.services.ai.capture.w2_b: Begin the yaw before the corner and ease toward the next wall in one continuous motion.
en.services.ai.capture.w2_title: Do not snap the phone through a corner.
en.services.ai.capture.w3_a: A close wall can fill the frame with a flat, repetitive surface while the camera moves sideways, making tracking easy to lose.
en.services.ai.capture.w3_b: Aim across the room instead, keeping depth, corners, and textured features in view.
en.services.ai.capture.w3_title: Do not face a nearby wall and walk parallel to it.

uz.settings.legal.privacy_body:
1. To'planadigan ma'lumotlar

Biz quyidagi ma'lumotlarni to'playmiz: telefon raqami, to'liq ism, elektron pochta (ixtiyoriy), skanerlangan obyekt rasmlari va joylashuv ma'lumotlari.

2. Ma'lumotlardan foydalanish

Ma'lumotlar faqat xizmat ko'rsatish, baholash natijalari tayyorlash va bildirishnomalar yuborish uchun ishlatiladi.

3. Ma'lumotlarni saqlash

Barcha ma'lumotlar shifrlangan holda O'zbekistondagi serverlarimizda saqlanadi. Uchinchi shaxslarga sotilmaydi.

4. Foydalanuvchi huquqlari

Siz o'z ma'lumotlaringizga kirish, o'zgartirish yoki o'chirish huquqiga egasiz. Buning uchun support@3dkadastr.uz manziliga murojaat qiling.

5. Kuzatish va analitika

Ilova faqat texnik ishlash uchun zarur bo'lgan minimal analitikadan foydalanadi.

6. Aloqa

privacy@3dkadastr.uz
uz.settings.legal.terms_body:
1. Umumiy qoidalar

Ushbu shartlar 3D kadastr ilovasidan foydalanish qoidalarini belgilaydi. Ilovadan foydalanib, siz ushbu shartlarga roziligingizni bildirasiz.

2. Xizmat tavsifi

3D kadastr — ko'chmas mulk obyektlarini 3D skanerlash, baholash va kadastr ma'lumotlarini boshqarish uchun mo'ljallangan platforma.

3. Foydalanuvchi majburiyatlari

Foydalanuvchi haqiqiy ma'lumotlar kiritishi, hisobni uchinchi shaxslarga bermasligi va qonuniy maqsadlarda foydalanishi shart.

4. Intellektual mulk

Ilova va uning barcha tarkibi 3D kadastr kompaniyasiga tegishli bo'lib, mualliflik huquqi bilan himoyalangan.

5. Javobgarlikni cheklash

Kompaniya texnik nosozliklar, uchinchi tomon xizmatlari yoki foydalanuvchi xatolaridan yuzaga keladigan zararlar uchun javobgar emas.

6. O'zgartirishlar

Kompaniya ushbu shartlarni oldindan ogohlantirmay o'zgartirish huquqini o'zida saqlab qoladi. Yangilangan shartlar ilovada e'lon qilinadi.

7. Bog'lanish
